findings.issue: וַיִּקְדָּשׁוּ is qal sequential imperfect 3mp. "se santificaron" adds an unmarked reflexive pronoun and turns the qal into self-sanctification.
רִקֻּעֵי (noun masculine plural construct) and פַחִים (noun masculine plural absolute) are smoothed into one noun plus an adjective.

notes: 2mp imperative וְעָשׂוּ as ustedes "hagan" is licensed; יהוה as Jehová is licensed.
